gui.gardentrails.discord: Check our socials: Discord, Patreon, Github, Youtube
lore.gardentrails.can_be_potted: Can be placed in a flower pot.
lore.gardentrails.grains_and_seeds_mix: Fertilizes plants like bone meal. Doubles the chance to tame parrots.
lore.gardentrails.quetzal_offering: Can be given to a colorful bird living in the jungle. It is the only gift it will accept to be tamed.
lore.gardentrails.quetzal_offering.bond: Once tamed, it lends its strength to whoever it accompanies. If it stays near plants, it will help them grow faster.
lore.gardentrails.sake_stacking: Effects accumulate when you drink more. Drink at your own risk.
lore.gardentrails.sake: Fill your stomach but slow you down.
lore.gardentrails.mulberry_flavored_sake: Rejuvenate you but lower your strength.
lore.gardentrails.maize_flavored_sake: Grant you strength at the cost of your health.
lore.gardentrails.grape_flavored_sake: Boosts your speed at the cost of your satiety.
lore.gardentrails.tea_flavored_sake: Improve your skill but make you more vulnerable.
lore.gardentrails.feathered_arrow: Does more damages than a regular arrow.
lore.gardentrails.rotten_arrow: Does less damages than a regular arrow. Inflicts Poison and Hunger on the target.
lore.gardentrails.quetzal_arrow: Does far more damages than a regular arrow.
message.gardentrails.quetzal_garden: The Quetzal will take care of your garden.
lore.gardentrails.drying_tray.label: Drying:
lore.gardentrails.drying_tray.usage: Place 4 items at a time to process them.
lore.gardentrails.pergola.label: Climbing Plant:
lore.gardentrails.pergola.usage: Shift + Right Click to remove plant
lore.gardentrails.grape_seeds: Plant on an Iron Pergola. Harvest when purple dots appear. Collect seeds once they turn dark to replant.
lore.gardentrails.cypress.grow: Right Click with a %s to make it grow taller.
lore.gardentrails.cypress.shrink: Shift + Right Click with an empty hand to shrink it.
lore.gardentrails.ivy: Spreads naturally on surrounding blocks, except %s. A %s or a %s can be used to control its growth.
lore.gardentrails.rotten_oak_log: Use a %s on this log to uncover %s.
lore.gardentrails.mold: Obtained by using a %s on a %s. Craft it with %s to make %s.
lore.gardentrails.rice: Essential to make sake. It must first be washed in a %s filled with water.
lore.gardentrails.washed_rice: Cook it in a %s to make %s.
lore.gardentrails.cooked_rice: Craft it with %s to make %s. It can also be used as an ingredient in a %s.
lore.gardentrails.moldy_rice: Place it in a %s and give it time to ferment into %s.
lore.gardentrails.fermented_rice: The essential base of every sake. Use it in a %s.
lore.gardentrails.sake_vat.base: Pour a %s and %s as the base, then add one ingredient to give the sake its flavor.
lore.gardentrails.sake_vat.collect: Wait for the fermentation, then use %s to collect the sake. One vat gives 3 bottles.
lore.gardentrails.mulberry: This plant produces %s, essential for the silk-making process.
lore.gardentrails.mulberry.silkmoths: This plant attracts Silkmoths. Place light nearby to keep them close and obtain %s from them.
lore.gardentrails.mulberry_leaves: Combined with %s, these leaves provide nourishment for the worms to hatch.
lore.gardentrails.stick_bundle: The perfect place to leave %s to develop.
lore.gardentrails.silk_worm_eggs: Combine with %s to nourish the eggs and let them grow into worms.
lore.gardentrails.silk_worm_hatchery: Place in a %s to let the worms hatch.
lore.gardentrails.silk_worms: Place on a %s and let them spin their cocoon.
lore.gardentrails.silk_cocoons: Craft these cocoons together to obtain %s.
lore.gardentrails.silk: A rare fiber, light as air and strong as iron. Can be used to craft fine objects and armor.

advancements.gardentrails.exploration.de: Don't fight with nature, eat it.

advancements.gardentrails.crafting.descr: Master the silk and the full crafting chain of Garden Trails.
advancements.gardentrails.botanist.title: Master Botanist
advancements.gardentrails.botanist.descr: Find every plant this mod has to offer.
advancements.gardentrails.bon_appetit.de: Eat everything that looks like food.

advancements.gardentrails.pitiless.descr: You are not a good man, Arthur Morgan.
